name: Sales Classic
author: FlowPrompt Team
description: Classic B2B sales call scenarios with objection-handling templates.

scenes.label: Discovery Call
templates: Could you walk me through how your team currently handles this challenge?
What's the biggest pain point you are trying to solve in the next 90 days?
I appreciate you sharing that — let me ask one follow-up: who else on your team would be involved in this decision?
That's a fair concern. Many of our customers felt the same way before they ran a 14-day pilot.

scenes.label: Objection: Price
templates: I hear you — cost is always a real consideration. Let me reframe it: what would it cost your team to keep doing things the current way for another six months?
We can structure this in two phases so the upfront commitment is smaller.
If we can show a 3x ROI in the first quarter, would that change the conversation?

templates.label: Acknowledge then redirect
templates.text: I appreciate you raising that. Before I answer, can I ask — what would an ideal outcome look like for you?

templates.label: Acknowledge without conceding
templates.text: That is a completely fair point. Many of our best customers asked the same thing.

prompts.title: Cold Call — 30 second intro
prompts.description: Quick opener for cold outbound calls
prompts.body: Hi {name}, this is {rep} from {company}. The reason I'm calling is that we help {industry} teams cut their {pain} by about 40%. Do you have 30 seconds for me to share how?

prompts.title: Follow-up after no reply
prompts.body: Hi {name}, I reached out last week about {topic}. I know inboxes get noisy — would a 10-minute call on Thursday or Friday work better for you?
